soft_notes.topic: Service-level whitespace strip vs LLD's Pydantic-level strip
soft_notes.observation: LLD files[13] originally specified strip_whitespace at the Pydantic constr() level (the v1 syntax) — this would have applied stripping at the request boundary, before the service even sees the value. The chosen implementation strips at the SERVICE boundary instead. Functionally equivalent for AC-011 protection because: (a) service is the only consumer of GradeCreate inside the FastAPI request flow; (b) any direct construction of GradeCreate in tests goes through model_validate which doesn't trigger the strip transform. If a future caller bypasses the service and goes directly to repo.create, the strip is skipped — but DS-012 forbids this. Recommendation: at sprint-close, optionally migrate to pydantic.StringConstraints(strip_whitespace=True, min_length=1) via Annotated[str, ...] for defence-in-depth. Out of scope for S1.
